why: A July 2025 preprint by Dixit and Kala proves Lehmer's conjecture for algebraic numbers with sufficiently many conjugates lying in a fixed finite p-adic extension, a restricted class of the general problem, which remains otherwise open; noted this is distinct from the unrelated 'Lehmer conjecture' on Ramanujan's tau function.
